changes: Pin one read-only APK file descriptor for daemon/reload/final restoration instead of reopening an installation path that may disappear.
Detach inherited standard streams so a broken output pipe after package replacement cannot terminate the outer cleanup shell.
Keep original installation path and version in the bounded lease; deleted/changed APK still stops the old daemon and restores native policy.

unit_tests.runner: JUnitCore on freshly compiled audio lifecycle fix classes

limits: Focused audio-upgrade regression only; unrelated features were not retested.
The historical 03:17 sequence cannot be reconstructed completely; two concrete failure conditions were reproduced independently and fixed.
Final-build replacement tests use 22->22 reinstall to force a new APK path; an earlier candidate also exercised 21->22.
No claim of survival if the cleanup shell itself is killed or the phone loses power.
The audio shared process was deliberately reloaded once; phone/system_server/SystemUI/audioserver were not restarted.
Initial transition from previously installed 2.1.5 cannot retroactively pin code for its already running old wrapper.
